'''Amadaine 11 (June 18)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|998}} - At the field on [[Battle of Talidar|Talidar]], [[Rand]]'s party find the [[Artur Hawkwing|Hawkwing]] monument, with a raven's head instead of a hawk. Rand rescues [[Lanfear#Mistress of Disguises|Selene]] from a pack of ''[[grolm]]''. She rides with them. Escaping another pack of ''grolm'', Rand uses another [[Portal Stone]] to take them back to their own world.
*{{ne|999}} - [[Elayne]] and [[Nynaeve]] arrive in [[Tanchico]], where they encounter [[Bayle Domon]] and take rooms at the [[Three Plum Court]]. Elayne gets drunk. In ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]'', Nynaeve sees [[Asmodean]] outside [[Rhuidean]] and is chased away by [[Birgitte]].
